diagnostics.message: aws_lambda_function.syncer configures VPC networking (dynamic vpc_config driven by var.lambda_subnet_ids), which requires the Lambda execution role to already have AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole (ENI/networking permissions) attached at the moment the function is created. The attachment resource aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.syncer_vpc_execution_role is not referenced by the function in any way, so Terraform may create the Lambda before the policy attachment lands, causing creation to fail with a "role does not have permissions" / network-interface error. No attribute of the Lambda can reference the attachment, so an explicit depends_on is the appropriate fix.
